title: The Psychogenic Machine: Simulating AI Psychosis, Delusion Reinforcement and Harm Enablement in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using 'psychosis-bench', a benchmark of 16 structured, 12-turn conversational scenarios simulating the progression of delusional themes. An LLM-as-a-judge is used to calculate a Delusion Confirmation Score (DCS), Harm Enablement Score (HES), and Safety Intervention Score (SIS) to quantify how often models deferentially agree with or reinforce user delusions.

Measuring the extent to which LLMs validate or amplify a user's stated delusional beliefs and harmful intent across both explicit and implicit conversational contexts, reflecting the tendency of RLHF-trained models to prioritize outputs that agree with the user's premise.
